description: Reviews answerLoops CLI commands that start a self-hosted instance with Docker Compose or download agent skill files into ./.claude/skills/. Help and usage output are not reviewed.
name: answerLoops CLI command protection
saferAlternatives: Confirm the target directory and that starting Docker containers on this machine is intended before running setup.
Read the skill files under skills/ in the answerLoops repository before installing them into ./.claude/skills/.
